invariants.statement: ACCEPTED requires VERIFIED_SUCCESS, COMPLIANT, evidence and no unresolved claims.
EFFECT_UNKNOWN can only produce EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT or MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED with UNDETERMINED normative status.
Gate crossing не доказывает dispatch, external effect, verification или acceptance.
Retry разрешён только при NO_EFFECT или доказанной идемпотентности.
Execution не создаёт AcceptanceDecision; Acceptance не выполняет primary effect.
Retry, verification probe и compensation имеют отдельные documents, gates и Permits.
Prompt Compiler детерминирован и не повышает epistemic status.
Provider prompt/cache не является источником истины.
PromptManifest binds the exact compiler-input projection and canonical messages; Model Gateway separately binds exact provider request bytes.
Execution and Acceptance remain separate responsibilities.
An execution attempt is not a recognized Outcome.
